article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Snow Days Return)
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing the seasonal Snow Days event in Snowhill, with the Gifting Tree presents, Candi Ivy's daily quest, the Abominable Snowman attacks and snowball fights, Everett's coal request, Robgoblin fights, and Snow Days outfits. The article gives no numbers and no exact post date; the relative 'posted 1 week, 4 days ago' against the 2010-12-19 capture suggests early December 2010.

article_summaries.title: Snow Days Returns

It covers the Gifting Tree daily presents, the Abominable Snowman attacks that players defend against with snowballs, Everett's coal request, snowball fights, and Snow Days outfits from the Marketplace and presents. article_summaries.title: Snow Days Are Here Again!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post (captured January 2013, listed as posted about 3 weeks 6 days before capture, so no absolute date) announcing the annual Snow Days event in Snowhill. It describes the Abominable Snowman attacks on the Gifting Tree, the Gifting Tree daily present quest, snowball fights, Robgoblin-related clothing and Snow Days outfits sold in the Marketplace or found in presents.
